criteria.requirement: Extend CodeBlock with caption option, using the original tag_code language/highlight/number-lines path and wrapping captioned output in an actual code-figure figure whose first child is literal_block and second is inline-parsed caption. Reject empty captions through directive option validation and preserve Unicode/multiline title text and original lexer error policy; do not replace code contents with raw HTML or a rubric.
